title: I go to the maktab
intro: Mirza’s first day at the maktab – and what we learn there.

learn.alt: A boy walking to the mosque with his mother and father
learn.caption: Mirza came to the maktab with his parents on the first day.

learn.html: On the first day, Mirza came to the maktab with his parents.

learn.alt: A teacher in front of children sitting at desks in the maktab

learn.html: Everyone met their mu‘allim and mu‘allimah (teachers), who will teach them about:

items: 🕌 Islamic duties – what Allah asks us to do

learn.alt: A teacher sitting with a boy and talking kindly

learn.html: Mirza was happy to see his friends again – and he made new friends too.

I go to the maktab, and I am proud of it –
I want to find happiness with it!
I go to the maktab, and I am full of joy –
to earn Jannah: happiness, treasure and gold.

practice.title: What do we learn in the maktab?
practice.prompt: Is it about belief, duties or manners?

questions.q: Who did Mirza come with on his first day?
What do we call our teacher in the maktab?
Which three things do we learn in the maktab?
In the song, what do we want to earn by going to the maktab?

practice.title: Tasks
prompts: 🎵 Learn the song “The maktab is calling me”.
✏️ Draw your maktab and the mosque.
👨‍👩‍👧 Tell your parents how your day at the maktab was.
